BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to No.38 Blackberry Rise, a beautifully presented 3 bedroom semi-detached home in this highly sought after family friendly neighbourhood located opposite a large open green space. The property offers style, comfort, turnkey finishes and the largest garden on the road providing great potential to extend.
 
The property briefly comprises of an entrance hall with understair storage, lounge, dining room with sliding doors to rear garden, open plan kitchen / breakfast area, utility and a downstairs shower room. On the first floor there are 3 spacious bedrooms and a large family bathroom. The attic has ladder for access and is partially floored. The rear garden has been lavished with care and attention with mature shrubs, plants and trees throughout and 3 different patio area’s capturing sun all day long. 

Situated near Portmarnock village ensuring easy access to a whole host of amenities including shops, cafes and Lidl Supermarket.  The Velvet Strand & Promenade, breath-taking coastal walks, the Sports and Leisure Centre are all within easy reach.  There are excellent primary and secondary schools within easy walking distance and bus stops close by ensuring easy access to Dublin City Centre.
